Lakeside Custom Printing

Lakeside is home to a diverse and hardworking community. With a population of over 21,000 as of 2020, it has a rich history dating back to 1886 and continues to be a hub for skilled trades and entrepreneurship. Lakeside thrives on the expertise of skilled professionals in various trades.

Custom Printing for Lakeside's Workforce

At ImageOn, we understand the unique needs of our local tradespeople and small business owners. We offer a range of services to help you promote your business and build your brand:

  1. Custom T-Shirts: Stand out on the job site with high-quality, durable custom t-shirts featuring your company logo.

  2. Embroidery Services: Add a professional touch to your workwear with our precision embroidery services.

  3. Commercial Printing: From business cards to banners, we've got all your commercial printing needs covered.

Why Choose Lakeside Custom Printing?

  • Local Expertise: We understand Lakeside's unique character and the needs of the community.

  • Quality Materials: We use top-grade materials that can withstand the demands of your work environment.

  • Fast Turnaround: We know time is money. Count on us for quick, efficient service.

  • Competitive Pricing: Fair prices that respect your hard-earned money.

Supporting the Community

As long as there are Sycamores and Mighty Mountains we are proud to serve Lakeside's rich history and vibrant present. Just as Lakeside has evolved from its early days of the Lakeside Hotel and famous racetrack, we're here to help your business grow and succeed in the modern era.

Frequently Asked Questions

Custom T-Shirt Printing serving Lakeside at Image On

Hey there! We're Image On, your go-to print shop serving Lakeside. We're proud to say we do all custom t-shirt work in-house. We love serving our San Diego County community. Let me walk you through some common questions about our T-shirt printing:

How much do we charge for T-shirt printing?

  • Our prices depend on a few things: how many shirts you want, what kind they are, and how complex your design is.
  • Good news for local businesses and teams in Lakeside - we offer great discounts on big orders!
  • We always aim to be upfront about our pricing. Give us a call at (619) 312-0941, and we'll give you all the details.

How quickly can we get your T-shirts ready?

  • We print everything right here in San Diego, so we can work pretty fast. Most orders are ready in 5 to 7 business days.
  • In a hurry? No problem! We can rush your order and have it done in 1 to 3 business days.
  • Need it even faster? We even offer same-day service for those last-minute emergencies.
  • We'll keep you in the loop throughout the process to make sure we meet your deadline.

Do we have a minimum order for T-shirt printing?

  • Nope! We're happy to print just one shirt, or we can handle orders of up to 10,000 if you need that many.
  • Remember, the more you order, the better deal we can give you. It's great for Lakeside businesses looking to save on bulk orders.

Can we handle last-minute T-shirt orders?

  • Absolutely! We're used to working with tight deadlines.
  • We're open from 9 AM to 7 PM, ready to help with your T-shirt emergencies.
  • Need it today? We offer same-day service for an extra fee.

Do we print photos on T-shirts?

  • You bet! We love turning your photos into wearable memories.
  • Our printing tech ensures your images come out clear and vibrant.
  • Family pics, pet portraits, special moments - we can put them all on a shirt for you.
  • Not sure how to layout your photo? Our team is here to help you design the perfect shirt.

What sizes do we offer?

  • We've got sizes for everyone - men, women, and kids.
  • From XS to plus sizes, we've got you covered.
  • We offer different styles too - crew necks, V-necks, tank tops, you name it.
  • Need a specific fit or style? Just ask - we probably have it!

At Image On, we're all about bringing your ideas to life on T-shirts. Whether you need one special shirt or thousands for your business, we're here to make it happen with quality and care. Got a cool idea for a shirt? Give us a call at (619) 312-0941 - we can't wait to hear about it!
